code_name: Emery Town Land Management and Development Code / zoning ordinance (text not found online)
edition: None found. District names come from the Emery County hosted Emery City Zoning Map (https://emery.utah.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Emery-City-Zone.pdf), legend only.
caveats: No Emery Town zoning ordinance text was found. emery.utah.gov hosts only the zoning map (legend: R-1 10,000 Residential, RR-1 Rural Residential, I-1 Light Industrial, CC-1 Central Commercial). ZoningPoint states no official zoning map or code is published online by the municipality. Utah public notices show a 2022 rezone of about 5.98 acres from R-1 to I-1 and 2024 hearings on amendments to the town Land Management and Development Code, so such a code exists but its text was not located.
The Emery County 2026 Zoning Ordinance (https://emery.utah.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/2026-Zoning-Ordinance.pdf) governs unincorporated county land and was not used for the town.
Do NOT substitute the Ferron or Huntington codes. Ask Emery Town Hall (65 N Center St) for the current Land Management and Development Code.
Every field except district names is null/empty because nothing was verified.
